source: Savix's and Xaryu's Twitch VODs of 12 Sep 2026, read frame by frame. Demo characters were level capped at 38.

notes: Victory Rush and Tactical Mastery are baseline.
No Intercept in Arms or Fury at 38; Intercept is trained at 30 in Classic, so its absence is the odd one -- the demo capped characters at 38. Bloodrage is confirmed in Protection.
Retaliation: 15 min cooldown, Battle Stance, counterattacks up to 30 melee hits for 15 sec.

Protection tab (Esfand's stream, 13 Sep 2026, clip by Zevzve): Bloodrage, Defensive Stance, Disarm, Revenge, Shield Bash, Shield Block, Shield Wall, Sunder Armor, Taunt. Last Stand is not in it, so it stays a talent.

newAbilities.name: Victory Rush
newAbilities.note: Confirmed baseline: it sits in the Arms tab of a level 38 Warrior's spellbook in the demo (Xaryu's Twitch VOD of 12 Sep 2026, 5h01m). Tooltip not read yet.

newAbilities.name: Tactical Mastery
newAbilities.note: Listed as a passive in the Arms tab of the same spellbook, so it is baseline now rather than a talent.

newAbilities.name: Intercept
newAbilities.note: Not in the Fury tab of the level 38 demo spellbook, where Classic teaches it at 30. Could be moved or gone; the demo was capped at 38, so nothing above that could show.

newAbilities.name: Slam
newAbilities.note: Changed: Rank 3 by level 38 in the demo spellbook, where Classic reaches Rank 3 at 46, so the ranks were reshuffled.

newAbilities.name: Bloodrage
newAbilities.note: Confirmed in the Protection tab of the level 38 demo spellbook (Esfand's stream, 13 Sep), alongside Shield Wall, Taunt and Sunder Armor.

notes: Undead Paladins exist, with Cannibalize and Will of the Forsaken in the General tab.

Blessing of Kings and Consecration are baseline: neither is a talent anywhere in the Forever trees, and both are in this book. Seal of Command is still a Retribution talent, so it is here because the demo Paladin had it.
Holy Strike is a baseline Retribution strike. Seal of Fury is back as a trainable seal.
Lay on Hands: 20 min cooldown, heals for your maximum health and restores 250 mana, drains your remaining mana.

newAbilities.name: Blessing of Kings and Consecration
newAbilities.note: Both baseline now: neither is a talent anywhere in the Forever trees, and both sit in a level 38 Undead Paladin's spellbook in the demo. Consecration is trained at level 20 per the Deep Dive panel.

newAbilities.name: Holy Strike
newAbilities.note: Baseline Retribution strike, Rank 5 by 38 in the demo spellbook. Instant weapon strike that deals Holy damage on a 12 sec cooldown; Improved Holy Strike, Iron Creed and Sacred Arbiter build on it.

newAbilities.name: Seal of Fury
newAbilities.note: The tank seal, trainable, Rank 4 by level 38 in the demo spellbook. Each melee hit deals Holy damage and, with a shield equipped, builds an absorb worth 50% of that damage. Improved Seal of Fury and Twist of Light refer to it.

newAbilities.name: Judgement
newAbilities.note: Changed: no longer consumes your seal. 10 yd range, 10 sec cooldown. Judging Seal of Fury deals Holy damage and taunts the target for 4 sec at 10 yd, so Paladins do have a taunt. Swift Judgement resets it for a second try. From the BlizzCon Deep Dive panel.

notes: Aimed Shot is baseline (a Classic Marksmanship talent).
Call Pet is named after the pet: this Hunter had Call Owl.
Explosive Trap and Viper Sting are trained by 38 (Classic: 44 and 36).
The fifth tab is the pet's own spellbook; it was not opened.

newAbilities.name: Aimed Shot
newAbilities.note: Baseline now (a Classic Marksmanship talent): Rank 3 by level 38 in the demo spellbook.

newAbilities.name: Call Owl
newAbilities.note: Call Pet is named after your pet in Forever; the demo Hunter's read Call Owl.

notes: Blade Flurry and Adrenaline Rush are Combat talents in Forever, so they are in this book because the demo rogue had them talented. Not baseline.
No Riposte in the book at 38, which just means that rogue had not taken it.
Blind at 38 with no reagent line visible; Disarm Trap is still trained.

newAbilities.name: Axes
newAbilities.note: Rogues can apparently wield one-handed axes now. Hack and Slash (Combat) lists Axe/Sword, Dagger/Fist and Mace as its weapon groups, and Classic rogues could not equip axes at all.

notes: Fear Ward is baseline for every Priest, in the Holy tab.
Devouring Plague is a normal Shadow spell now, Rank 3 on a Night Elf.
Elune's Grace changed: 5 min cooldown, 50% chance to be missed by melee and ranged for 15 sec or until missed 3 times.
No Shadow Word: Death by 38; the talent tooltips mention it, so it is probably trained later. The demo was capped at 38.

newAbilities.name: Shadow Word: Death
newAbilities.note: Execute-style Shadow spell; mentioned by Early Demise.

newAbilities.name: Devouring Plague
newAbilities.note: Now a normal Shadow spell rather than an Undead racial: a Night Elf Priest has it at Rank 3 by level 38 in the demo spellbook, on a 1 min cooldown. Also mentioned by Devouring Contagion.

newAbilities.name: Fear Ward
newAbilities.note: Baseline for every Priest now: sits in the Holy tab of a Night Elf Priest's spellbook in the demo, 3 min cooldown.

notes: Call of the Ancestors and Call of the Elements are new Elemental abilities; Totemic Projection and Totemic Recall are new too.
Fire Nova is a spell with ranks (Rank 3 by 38), no longer a totem.
Chain Lightning is trained by 38 (Classic: 32) and Windfury Totem and Weapon are both in by 38.

newAbilities.name: Totemic Projection
newAbilities.note: New Enhancement ability in the demo spellbook; Totemic Recall also exists.

newAbilities.name: Fire Nova
newAbilities.note: Talent tooltips call it "your Fire Nova spell" and give it a cooldown (Improved Fire Nova: +10% damage, -2 sec cooldown). In Classic it was Fire Nova Totem. Also named in Call of Flame and Elemental Reach.

newAbilities.name: Lightning Bolt
newAbilities.note: Casts 0.5 sec faster than Classic at baseline. Rank 7: 135 mana, 30 yd, 2.5 sec cast, 102 to 113 Nature damage (Classic rank 7 was 3 sec). Read from Guzu's stream on an Enhancement Shaman with no haste buff up, captured by Schiffers.

newAbilities.name: Chain Lightning
newAbilities.note: Also 0.5 sec faster at baseline. Rank 1: 225 mana, 2 sec cast, 6 sec cooldown, 64 to 71 Nature, each jump 30% weaker, 3 targets (Classic rank 1 was 2.5 sec). With 3 of 3 Elemental Alacrity that lands at the same 2 sec Lightning Bolt Classic's 5-point Lightning Mastery gave.

notes: Arcane Blast and Presence of Mind are both Arcane talents in Forever, so they are here because the demo Mage had them talented. Not baseline.
Comprehend Scroll is a new General ability, seen on Savix's Skyborne Mage.
The Frost tab was shown with every rank listed; the highest rank of each spell is what is recorded here.

Fire at 38 is five spells: Fire Blast Rank 5 (110 mana, 8 sec cooldown, 261 to 309), Fireball Rank 7 (220 mana, 3.5 sec cast, 220 to 271 plus 24 over 8 sec), Scorch, Fire Ward and Flamestrike. No Pyroblast or Blast Wave by 38.

newAbilities.name: Comprehend Scroll
newAbilities.note: New General ability seen on a Skyborne Mage in the demo.

newAbilities.name: Frostfire Bolt
newAbilities.note: Fire and Frost bolt; mentioned by Improved Fireball, Hot Streak, Missile Barrage and Incineration.

notes: Curse of Agony is Bane of Agony. Enslave Demon is Subjugate Demon.
Incubus and Succubus are separate summons.
Shadow Ward is baseline. Destruction tab read from Soda's stream and matches the Goldshire trainer list exactly.
Pet tab is the Felhunter's: Devour Magic rank 2, Spell Lock, Tainted Blood.

newAbilities.name: Subjugate Demon
newAbilities.note: Enslave Demon renamed; Rank 1 by 38 in the demo spellbook. Incubus and Succubus are separate summons.

newAbilities.name: Bane of Agony
newAbilities.note: Curse of Agony renamed; mentioned by Improved Bane of Agony, Amplify Curse and Pandemic.

newAbilities.name: Bane of Doom
newAbilities.note: Curse of Doom renamed; mentioned by Pandemic.

newAbilities.name: Incubus
newAbilities.note: Male counterpart to the Succubus; mentioned by Fel Vitality, Fel Domination, Demonic Sacrifice and Improved Sayaad.

notes: Nature's Grasp and Omen of Clarity are baseline (Classic Balance and Restoration talents).
Revive is new: 10 sec cast, 300 health and 520 mana, out of combat. Rebirth keeps its 30 min cooldown and Stranglethorn Seed.
Cure Poison is gone; Abolish Poison is the only poison cure.

newAbilities.name: Omen of Clarity and Nature's Grasp
newAbilities.note: Both baseline now (Classic talents): they sit in a level 38 Night Elf Druid's Balance tab in the demo.

newAbilities.name: Revive
newAbilities.note: New out-of-combat resurrection: 10 sec cast, brings a player back with 300 health and 520 mana at Rank 3. Rebirth keeps its 30 min cooldown.

newAbilities.name: Cure Poison
newAbilities.note: Gone. Abolish Poison is the only poison cure in the demo spellbook.
